scientific_limitations: Aligned positively homothetic simplex testing bodies only; positive overlap; all dimensions at least two. Small-scale construction deliberately extends beyond the ball-convexity hypotheses of the motivating theory. The included finite LP checks are ancillary to the proof.
title: Exact homothetic-simplex translate cores and a sharp extinction threshold
